recovery.md#Worker recovery
This document governs recovery of production rendering workers after interrupted writes.
recovery.md#Recovery procedure
Follow all child sections in order when recovering an interrupted worker.
recovery.md#Isolate
Disable the worker lease before inspecting temporary outputs.
recovery.md#Isolate
Preserve the failed job identifier in the incident record.
recovery.md#Validate
Compare every completed derivative checksum with its job manifest.
recovery.md#Validate
Delete only temporary outputs that have no completed manifest entry.
recovery.md#Resume
Re-enable the worker lease after checksum validation finishes.
recovery.md#Resume
Jobs with a checksum mismatch remain quarantined and must not be retried automatically.
publication.md#Derivative publication
Publication rules apply to visitor-visible derivatives, not internal previews.
publication.md#Approval
Publish only after both curator approval and checksum verification are recorded.
publication.md#Approval
Include the preserved-original identifier with every published derivative.
publication.md#Embargo
An active collection embargo prevents publication even after curator approval and checksum verification.
publication.md#Embargo
Wait for explicit embargo release; reaching a scheduled render date does not release it.
withdrawal.md#Withdrawal
Replace the public derivative with a withdrawal notice and retain its original identifier.
withdrawal.md#Withdrawal
Keep the audit record and preserved camera original.
withdrawal.md#Withdrawal
Do not silently redirect the identifier to a different object.
